Agent Client Protocol schema pin - provenance record

This directory vendors two unmodified files published by the Agent Client
Protocol project's schema release. Both are read only by test code and by
the Go source generator; a testdata/ directory is excluded from every Go
build, so neither file reaches the compiled binary.

Upstream repository: https://github.com/agentclientprotocol/agent-client-protocol
Tag:    schema-v1.23.0
Commit: 6d08f412a7a1370d3cc9a124e3be3d6acf92641e
Upstream license at that commit: Apache License 2.0

Format: each asset line below has the form
  <relative-file-path> <byte-count> sha256:<hex-digest>
fields are separated by a single space; the hex digest is lowercase and
follows the literal prefix "sha256:". A test asserts that each listed
file's sha256 equals the value recorded here.

schema.json 247168 sha256:3c17bd6385d90cf672d8a661fddc359d73422cf8b8ce6865213d25cfd4c0eca7
meta.json 1159 sha256:061edb6efa8fb2aa2792459a86ec7268de5fe665bba48b2ffe7939df01481f88

Upstream source paths at the pinned commit:
  schema.json came from schema/v1/schema.json
  meta.json came from schema/v1/meta.json
